text:
Rae: short question for the sidebar IA regroup: when a user opens a canonical deep-link (e.g. /org/ember/workspaces/77/pipelines/build-7) should we (A) expand the Pipelines group and focus the item, (B) only reveal/highlight it, or (C) reveal + show an ephemeral banner telling the user we changed the nav state? looking for accessibility & UX balance.
Oli: accessibility-first -> expand+reveal and make the target programmatically focusable. otherwise SR users land in a collapsed list and get lost. set aria-expanded on the group and aria-current="page" on the item.
Sam: agree but add nuance: only show the ephemeral banner for external referrers. If someone clicks an internal link inside the app we probably dont need the banner. router can detect document.referrer or a small internal flag. banner copy: "Opened via link: Pipelines expanded" with an Undo button that collapses.
Kei: implementation suggestion: on router mount translate canonical route -> nav open+select. then:
```js
expandGroup('pipelines');
const el = document.getElementById('nav-pipeline-build-7');
el?.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
el?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
const nav = document.getElementById('left-nav');
nav?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
```
This prevents page jumps and keeps scroll confined to the nav container.
Rae: question about announcements: should we use aria-live polite to tell screen reader users "Pipelines expanded, Build 7 selected"? or rely on aria-current + breadcrumb SR label?
Oli: aria-live polite is helpful for external loads. But avoid double-announcing. If we set aria-current and also have a breadcrumb with aria-label the SR may already announce. I suggest aria-live polite with a short string only when the expansion is performed by a deep-link and the nav container was previously collapsed.
Sam: UX edge: if user previously manually collapsed Pipelines, deep-link should override on initial load (explicit intent). But if the user collapses it manually after the deep-link, persist that preference in localStorage and don't auto-open on subsequent navigations.
Kei: animation + motion: animate expand with 120ms slide+fade unless prefers-reduced-motion. keep CSS contained; avoid layout shifts that affect main content.
AnnounceBot: created ticket A11Y-412 "deep-link reveal + conditional aria-live + undo banner" and added to QA checklist.
Rae: keyboard flow to validate for the PR: Tab -> left nav region (role=navigation) -> ArrowDown to group header -> RightArrow/Enter expands -> programmatic focus lands on item (preventScroll) -> Enter activates. Test with NVDA, VoiceOver and JAWS. Include reduced-motion variant in the prototype.
Oli: small copy nit for breadcrumbs: use mid-dot separators (•). screen-reader label: "Breadcrumbs: Org, Workspace, Pipelines, Build 7". tooltip for truncated crumbs.
Sam: action items: (1) router mount hook to map path -> nav open+select (Sam), (2) programmatic focus + preventScroll + confined scrollIntoView (Kei), (3) ephemeral external-referrer banner with Undo + persist manual toggles (Rae), (4) aria-live politeness guard to avoid double-announcement (Oli), (5) add e2e a11y checks and keyboard gif for PR (AnnounceBot).
Rae: I'll update Figma frames and add a short GIF + reduced-motion variant. tagging @Sam @Kei @Oli — thanks! :sparkles:
